thread.title: Apple CEO: Dividend hikes ahead, succession planning a priority

author: Bloomberg News
title: Apple CEO: Dividend hikes ahead, succession planning a priority
text:
Apple Inc. Chief Executive Officer Tim Cook told shareholders at the company’s annual meeting to expect higher dividends and stressed that succession planning is a priority.
Cook was asked if shareholders would receive a special dividend this year as part of Apple ( AAPL.O ) bringing hundreds of billions of dollars in cash back to the U.S. The CEO said he’s "not a fan" of special dividends but said the company’s board remains "committed" to annual dividend increases. Directors will discuss the issue in April, as in previous years, he noted at the meeting inside the company’s new Steve Jobs Theater, in Cupertino, California.
Cook also made some of his most explicit comments on succession planning, saying that one of his most important roles as CEO is properly "passing the baton" to a new leader. Every Apple board meeting in recent years has had succession planning on the agenda for all key executive roles, he said.
